ranked.headline: Diffusion and agentic models steer multi-objective biomolecular sequence generation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints add RL fine-tuning, Pareto rewards, and explicit control targets to discrete diffusion and LLM agents for biomolecular design.

ranked.headline: ML models infer tumor molecular states from histology, imaging and multi-omics data
ranked.summary: Routine histology, MRI and multi-omics data are increasingly mapped to tumor molecular states, with benchmarking against held-out data.

ranked.headline: Learned models link cell states and interactions across single-cell and spatial data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply graph neural networks and foundation models to spatial and multiome data for regulatory and cell-cell inference.

ranked.headline: Methods correct RNA-seq biases and infer regulatory programs in bulk and single-cell data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints address sample-level scale distortion, single-cell longitudinal power, and database-free interaction inference from transcriptomic data.

ranked.headline: LLM agents with expert oversight turn literature into structured biomedical records
ranked.summary: Expert-in-the-loop LLM workflows are being used to extract assay records, causal evidence, and executable model configurations from published literature.

ranked.headline: Probabilistic models of sequence data reshape protein and RNA estimates
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test how modeling survivorship bias, sampling dynamics, and training-data structure changes inferred protein and RNA estimates.

ranked.headline: Context-aware genetic models map regulatory effects of variants, repeats and proteins
ranked.summary: Imputed short tandem repeats in 336 cortex samples now resolve splicing effects alongside large proteogenomic and colocalisation analyses.

ranked.headline: Biology-informed representations for predicting molecular and protein properties
ranked.summary: Structure, activity-profile and confidence information is being built into predictive models and tested against curated benchmark datasets.

ranked.headline: Reverse vaccinology across TB strains yields conserved epitope vaccine candidates
ranked.summary: Strain-level genomic data are now mined computationally to design broad-coverage vaccines and drug targets for tuberculosis and bovine TB.

ranked.headline: LLM-selected preprocessing and shape benchmarks for single-cell and biomolecular imaging
ranked.summary: Released benchmarks and deep-learning tools target automated quantification across single-cell transcriptomics, AFM imaging, and cytology datasets.

ranked.headline: Learned microbiome transformers and perturbation benchmarks test generalization limits
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair pretrained transformers with standardized benchmarks to test where learned biological models generalize.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models tie microbial switching and spatial structure to invasion and fitness
ranked.summary: Preprints from May 2026 use mechanistic models to link explicit architecture, not average effect size, to which qualitative outcome emerges.

ranked.headline: LLM agents couple retrieval and multimodal patient or omics data to biomedical inference
ranked.summary: Agent and LLM systems are now benchmarked on clinical discovery, rare disease diagnosis, omics reasoning and reproducibility, making evaluation central.

ranked.headline: Metagenomic detection pipelines diverge widely on resistance gene counts
ranked.summary: Benchmarks and control-free contamination checks now expose how pipeline choice and read quality shift microbial genomic results.

ranked.headline: Protein language models are adapted via new objectives, fine-tuning, and task heads
ranked.summary: Pretrained ESM-2, ESM-C, and ProGen3 embeddings are now being repurposed for structure, enzyme, operon, and PTM site prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Computational methods extend Cas9 PAM range and guide design across nucleic acid contexts
ranked.summary: Computational workflows now yield PAM-relaxed SaCas9 variants and prioritize exon-skipping ASO target regions from splicing data.

ranked.headline: Long-read and single-cell methods resolve haplotype and copy-number genome structure
ranked.summary: Recent preprints benchmark long-read phasing and validate single-cell DNA content inference against reference or orthogonal measurements.

ranked.headline: Reduced-precision and SDE methods extend stochastic simulation of biological systems
ranked.summary: Stochastic simulation and inference methods are being reformulated for precision, noise, and cross-laboratory variability in biological models.

ranked.headline: Simulations probe membrane insertion energetics and mycobacterial outer membrane structure
ranked.summary: Unbiased and all-atom MD now resolve side-chain insertion energetics and mycobacterial outer membrane dynamics at molecular detail.

ranked.headline: Nanopore and long-read methods benchmarked against orthogonal reference truth
ranked.summary: Long-read RNA and genome methods are increasingly judged against orthogonal data, with nanopore RNA modification calls showing discordance.

ranked.headline: Deep learning fuses sequence and language-model embeddings for regulatory prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair protein or genomic language model embeddings with sequence inputs to predict binding, motifs and variant impact.

ranked.headline: ML tools refine cryo-EM map segmentation, model building, and coarse-grained dynamics
ranked.summary: AlphaFold-informed segmentation and learned potentials now feed atomic model building from experimental cryo-EM maps.

ranked.headline: Quantum residue descriptors and physics Hamiltonians are being applied to peptide design
ranked.summary: Physics-based Hamiltonians and quantum descriptors of noncanonical residues are now being used to frame peptide design and simulation analysis.

ranked.headline: LLM agents turn protocols and omics data into verifiable, auditable artifacts
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair LLM agents with compilers, executable protocol languages and execution feedback to make biomedical workflows auditable.

ranked.headline: Histology and imaging models infer molecular profiles from spatial and multiview data
ranked.summary: Deep models now predict spatial gene expression from H&E slides and impute across imaging views, extending molecular inference beyond direct measurement.

ranked.headline: Computational tools span proteomics QC, PTM structural modeling and drug mechanism
ranked.summary: Large-scale proteomics and screening datasets now demand automated QC, PTM interpretation, and agentic AI analysis from raw MS data.

ranked.headline: Computational corrections for technical artifacts in spatial and single-cell omics data
ranked.summary: Higher-resolution spatial and single-cell platforms need artifact removal and variance-aware batch evaluation before biological interpretation.

ranked.headline: MD and physics models resolve allostery, substrate networks and disorder recognition
ranked.summary: Explicit physical models are increasingly used to interpret allostery, substrate recognition and generative protein design.

ranked.headline: Learned models predict TCR, MHC and KIR recognition of peptides and immunogenicity
ranked.summary: Benchmarks and deep learning now target bidirectional TCR-peptide generation, HLA peptide abundance and KIR-HLA interaction strengths.

ranked.headline: Graph-based models infer biomolecular networks and methylation-based biological age
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published method extend graph inference to multi-relational CpG graphs, resampling-based networks, and early-warning detection.

ranked.headline: Network structure, adaptive behavior, and mobility shape epidemic inference and spread
ranked.summary: Recent work quantifies how contact structure, self-protective behavior, and mobility alter transmission estimates and outbreak dynamics.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic ODE models link molecular mechanisms to quantitative, testable predictions
ranked.summary: Model reduction, structural model selection, and ensemble sampling now derive quantitative predictors from mechanistic pathway models.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking and new tools for pathogen genome analysis across viral and bacterial data
ranked.summary: Pipelines for viral detection, longitudinal variant tracking, and long-read simulation are now being benchmarked against real sequencing data.

ranked.headline: Time-resolved single-cell models link dynamics to fate, chromatin and lineage history
ranked.summary: Single-cell readouts now carry time-informative information from chromatin, barcodes, imaging and spatial context into dynamical models.

ranked.headline: Evaluating and extending MS/MS-based small-molecule structure inference
ranked.summary: Benchmark validity, transformation prediction, and calibrated retrieval are being reexamined to test what models learn from MS/MS spectra.

ranked.headline: Pipelines turning microbial sequencing reads into taxonomic and quality outputs
ranked.summary: Large public metagenomic catalogs, such as the 60,126-run MENA collection, now sit alongside new reproducible workflows for reads and spectra.

ranked.headline: Open tools for assessing and visualizing graph, protein, and metabolite predictions
ranked.summary: Four early-May 2026 preprints release tools for evaluating and visualizing genomic graph and protein prediction outputs.

ranked.headline: Explicit shape parameters are tied to flow, tissue mechanics, and planar morphometry
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair explicit shape parameterizations with flow simulation, quasi-conformal morphing, and gradient-based tissue morphogenesis inversion.

ranked.headline: Dynamic metabolic models couple enzyme regulation, microbial growth, and host dynamics
ranked.summary: Three 2026 preprints pair kinetic and constraint-based metabolic models with Bayesian inference and microbiome forecasting.

ranked.headline: Explicit latent and geometric models of shared variability in neural populations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints treat correlated population activity as explicit latent or geometric structure rather than noise to be averaged away.
